[翻译]Echeveria xichuensis原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=113&x270_id=1159&x270_listsearch=1
翻译：种花小医杂家赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。XICHUENSIS Lopez & Reyes, 1998
xichuensis 洛佩兹&雷耶斯，1998Series Angulatae
鱿鱼/剑司系Distribution : Mexico (Guanajuato)
分布：墨西哥（瓜纳华托）Description :
描述：Stem lacking or 5 cm tall.
无茎干或者茎干5cm高。Rosette 10 - 12 cm in diameter.
莲座直径约10 - 12厘米。Leaves 15 - 20, ovate to obovate or oblanceolate, acute or obtuse, 6 x 2.7 cm, to 3 mm thick, dark olive green tinged purple, with transverse and longitudinal markings.
叶15～20，卵形到倒卵形或倒披针形，有锐尖或钝圆，6×2.7厘米，3毫米厚，深橄榄绿色微染紫色，有横向和纵向的暗纹。Inflorescence a cincinnus to more than 50 cm long with up to 25 flowers, bracts numerous, ca 2 x 0,4 cm, pedicels 3 – 3 mm.
花序：蝎尾状聚伞花序，可长达50厘米。花序上较多可生长25朵花，附生较多小叶，大约2×0.4厘米，花梗3–3毫米。Flowers : Sepals spreading or ascending, unequal, up to 9,5 mm, corolla ca 11 mm long, ca 7 mm in diameter at base, 5 mm in diameter at mouth, pink at base, salmon higher up and light orange inside, petal tips slightly outcurved.
花：萼片平展或上翘，各个苞片长度不等，长可达9.5毫米。花冠约11毫米长，基部约7毫米直径，花口部直径5毫米，花基部呈现粉色，至花冠部逐渐过渡为鲑鱼红色，花内部浅橙色，花瓣尖稍外翻。Cytology : n = 32 ? ?
细胞学检查：染色体可能为32We consider E. xichuensis sufficiently different from E. humilis to be a good species and not synonymous with the latter as published in IHSP 2003.
ICN站观点：我们认为E. xichuensis 与 E. humilis有极大的区别，足以作为一个独立物种存在。且与发表在IHSP 2003上的后者也不是同物异名。附上E. humilis的图片，来自微博花友恋恋多肉季
